channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Republic Day: Indian Army showcases four-legged warriors in a historic first
item.description: India witnessed a rare spectacle on its 77th Republic Day when a specially curated animal contingent of the Indian Army's Remount and Veterinary Corps (RVC) marched down Kartavya Path, underscoring the indispensable role animals play in defending the country's most demanding frontiers.

item.title: Bihar Celebrates 77th Republic Day with Grand Ceremonies Across the State
item.description: Bihar, along with the rest of the country, celebrated the 77th Republic Day on Monday with patriotic fervour and elaborate ceremonies across the state.

item.title: ‘IND-NZ series was appetiser, main course begins from Feb 7’: Gavaskar on India’s T20 WC title defence preps
item.description: Former India captain Sunil Gavaskar praised Team India’s preparations ahead of their T20 World Cup title defence, noting that the Men in Blue are ‘not taking the World Cup lightly and not taking anything for granted.’

item.title: HM Amit Shah to visit Gujarat tomorrow
item.description: Union Home Minister Amit Shah is scheduled to visit Gujarat again on January 27, marking another significant engagement in his home state this month.

item.title: Private jet crashes at US Maine airport amid snowstorms
item.description: Bangor International Airport said in a statement that emergency crews responded to the accident at around 7:45 p.m. Eastern Time (0045 GMT Monday), and the airport has been closed temporarily, Xinhua news agency reported.

item.title: Hockey India Congratulates Savita Punia, Baldev Singh on Padma Shri Honour
item.description: Hockey India on Monday congratulated Indian women’s hockey legend Savita Punia and former India international Baldev Singh on receiving the prestigious Padma Shri award, honouring their exceptional contributions to Indian hockey and sports overall.

item.title: Ravi Teja’s film with Shiva Nirvana titled ‘Irumudi’
item.description: The makers of director Shiva Nirvana's upcoming film, featuring actor Ravi Teja in the lead, on Monday announced the title of the film as 'Irumudi'.

item.title: King Charles sends Republic Day greetings to President Murmu, lauds India-UK ties
item.description: Britain’s King Charles III has written to President Droupadi Murmu, conveying his and Queen Camilla’s warm greetings to the government and people of India on the occasion of the country’s 77th Republic Day, while lauding the enduring and close ties between the two nations.

item.title: Karnataka Congress to stage ‘Raj Bhavan Chalo’ protest against scrapping of MGNREGA
item.description: Deputy Chief Minister and Karnataka Pradesh Congress Committee (KPCC) president D.K. Shivakumar announced the decision on Monday after taking part in Republic Day celebrations at the party headquarters in Bengaluru.

item.title: R-Day celebrations held for first time in Andhra Pradesh capital Amaravati
item.description: For the first time, Republic Day celebrations were organised in the Andhra Pradesh capital, Amaravati. Governor S. Abdul Nazeer unfurled the national flag at the main official ceremony to mark the 77th Republic Day celebrations.
